reasons.correctness: @Version Long field and a BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 column match the interface, and 2/2 acceptance tests pass. The version is not in UserPreferencesDtoIn/DtoOut, so a stale read-edit-write from the other device can still overwrite.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset path, name, formatted-sql header, rollback and the changelog.xml include with its month comment are all correct. The tests went into the existing UserPreferencesServiceUnitTest instead of a new *UnitTest class.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one field on the entity plus one changeset. It reuses the existing @Version pattern and the OptimisticLock handler in BusinessExceptionHandler. No new mechanism and no unrelated edits.
reasons.test_quality: A reflection test checks the @Version annotation and the Long type. A ModelMapper test checks that mapping a DtoIn keeps the version. Neither exercises a concurrent-update conflict or an ObjectOptimisticLockingFailure path. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the userpreferences package, the dependents of UserPreferences and its TESTED_BY tests before any edit. The existing @Version examples and changesets were then found by grep, and one graph query failed.
